title: Bodo saltans culture protocol
author: Fatma Gomaa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sh6eb9e
materials: Invert several times to dissolve the DMSO.
Allow to warm to room temperature

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Harvest cells from a peak‑density culture by centrifuging at 800 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare 20% sterile DMSO solution
steps.instruction: Make a 20 % (v/v) sterile DMSO solution in fresh Bodo medium.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.0 mL sterile DMSO to an ice‑cold tube.
Place the tube on ice and allow the DMSO to solidify (~5 min).
Add 8.0 mL ice‑cold fresh Bodo medium to obtain a 20 % (v/v) DMSO solution.

steps.title: Mix cells with DMSO solution
steps.instruction: Combine the harvested cell suspension and the 20 % DMSO solution in equal volumes, yielding a final cell density of 1 × 10⁶–1 × 10⁷ cells/mL and 10 % (v/v) DMSO; wait 15–30 minutes before freezing.

steps.title: Aliquot into sterile cryovials
steps.instruction: Dispense 0.5 mL of the mixture into sterile 1.0–2.0 mL screw‑capped cryovials (cryules).

steps.title: Freeze vials with controlled‑rate method
steps.instruction: Freeze the cryovials using a controlled‑rate freezer or an alternative apparatus.

substeps.instruction: In a controlled‑rate freezer, cool from room temperature at –1 °C/min to –40 °C; if the unit compensates for the heat of fusion, maintain the 1 °C/min rate through the fusion event, then plunge vials into liquid nitrogen.
Alternatively, place vials in a Nalgene 1 °C freezing apparatus, set the apparatus at –80 °C for 1.5–2 hours (cooling rate ≈ –1 °C/min), then plunge vials into liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Thaw vials in 35 °C water bath
steps.instruction: Place each frozen ampule in a water bath set to +35 °C, immersing it just above the surface of the frozen material; do not agitate.

steps.title: Inoculate flask with thawed cells
steps.instruction: Immediately after thawing, aseptically transfer the contents into a T‑25 tissue‑culture flask containing 10 mL Bodo medium bacterized with Klebsiella pneumoniae subsp. pneumoniae (ATCC® 700831).

steps.title: Incubate culture at 22 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the flask horizontally with the cap tightly screwed on at 22 °C.

steps.title: Adjust cell concentration in fresh medium
steps.instruction: Adjust the cell concentration to 2 × 10⁶–1 × 10⁷ cells/mL in fresh Bodo medium (important for downstream applications such as transfection).
